root_idea.summary: The root centers on depth understood as distance downward, especially the distance from the opening of a well to its bottom; with routes and places, this extends to remoteness or far extension.
root_idea.development: The semantic development runs from the vertical depth of wells to the distance or length of roads and places, and further to penetrating or excessive depth in speech and affairs.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized masculine singular adjective citation form عَمِيقٌ.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Qur'anic construction مِنْ كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ, it describes a distant or far-reaching pass or route; this is the sense of remoteness or extension, not the vertical depth of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become deep, as a well; to be or become far-extending or long, as a pass or road; and, of a place, to be distant or remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verbal use; the object or setting determines whether the sense is vertical depth or distance and extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bottom or depth of a well, road, valley, or similar formation; the distance to the bottom; also the depth of a thing or deep places of the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal use, with several recorded vocalic variants and plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The distant or remote extremity of a desert; by extension, a side, region, tract, or extremity of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical use referring to remote reaches or regions rather than vertical depth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full-grown unripe dates placed in the sun to dry and ripen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical and agricultural noun use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A right or due belonging to someone in a property or matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions asserting that a person has a due or entitlement in something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To examine or investigate affairs deeply, beyond the usual bounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II transitive use, especially with النظر into affairs.
Form IV transitive use with a well as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go deeply or far into speech, a thing, or an affair; figuratively, to become excessively exacting or to exceed the usual bounds in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V use, commonly with في; the sense may be literal penetration or figurative over-elaboration and excessive exactness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of tree or plant found in the Hijaz and Tihamah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun; عَمَاقِيَةٌ is recorded as an associated form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose speech has depth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive expression applied to the quality of a person's speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel feeding on the plant عِمْقَى; عَامِقَةٌ may describe camels feeding on it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-related adjective derived from the plant name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deep in the vertical sense, especially said of a well; أَعْمَقُ means deeper or deepest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Classical use concerns physical depth and is distinct from the Qur'anic use meaning far-extending or remote.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who exceeds the usual bounds in an affair, applying forced hardness, vigor, or endurance while seeking its utmost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description of excessive or strenuous engagement with an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Feculence or residue of clarified butter adhering to the inside of a skin container.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for the adhering residue inside a skin used to contain clarified butter.
